why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the DeBank XP page Go to the DeBank XP page , which the homepage card for DeBank XP links to.
2 Step 2 : Join Quests Take part in Quests on DeBank. Completing at least one action in a Quest also qualifies a user with a minted Web3 ID for the Quest Participant badge.
3 Step 3 : Interact with the community The homepage lists interacting with the community as a way to earn XP and links its Stream section , without saying what to post.
4 Step 4 : Refer others to DeBank The homepage names referring others, alongside Quests and community interaction, as a way to earn DeBank XP. It does not describe how referrals work.
5 Step 5 : Stay active on chain The homepage asks users to keep up their on-chain activity so XP keeps building. Check the DeBank homepage for news on redeeming XP.
